Do you speak a foreign language?

Let me introduce my friend Ken.

items.audioEn: Hi, I am Sam. I am a reporter from a foreign newspaper.
items.audioZh: 嗨，我是 Sam，我是一家外國報社的記者。

items.sentenceEn: Please write your personal information here.
items.sentenceZh: 請在這裡填寫你的個人資料。

items.sentenceEn: My sister works for a foreign bank.

items.stemZh: 請在這裡寫下你家的地址。

items.passageEn: Today a new student is in our class. The teacher introduces her to us. Her name is Nina, and she is from Korea. She can speak three languages. A reporter from the school newspaper asks her some questions. Nina says, "Thank you. I am happy to be here."
items.passageZh: 今天我們班上有一位新同學。老師把她介紹給我們。她的名字是 Nina，來自韓國。她會說三種語言。校刊的一位記者問了她一些問題。Nina 說：「謝謝，我很高興來到這裡。」

questions.questionZh: 誰把 Nina 介紹給大家？

items.promptZh: 對不起，我不知道你的名字。
referenceEn: Sorry, I don't know your name.
I am sorry, I do not know your name.
rubricZh: 道歉可用 sorry（例如 Sorry、I am sorry、I'm sorry）
否定可用 do not 或 don't（例如 I don't know your name）

items.promptZh: 老師把新同學介紹給全班。
referenceEn: The teacher introduces the new student to the class.
The teacher introduced the new student to the class.
rubricZh: introduce 後面接被介紹的人，介紹給誰用 to（例如 introduce the new student to the class）
題目沒有時間，現在式或過去式（例如 introduces、introduced）都正確
